about: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides consumer and MSME financing services in India. The company offers prime personal, gold, education, consumer durable, commercial vehicle, shopkeeper, instant consumer, pre-owned car, business, mid-market, machinery and medical equipment, and professional loans, and loan against property, as well as NBFC lending. It also provides supply chain financing and credit leasing services. In addition, the company offers insurance services
